Keep 300 rescued animals fed and treated

ALIR is a non-profit with no government funding. Many of our animals arrive abused, injured or chronically ill. Your donation pays for their food, medicine and vet care.

After you give

  1. Donate

    We post updates on each animal in our rescue stories.
